messages:
Maya - People Ops: Heads-up  Satellite cohort arriving Tue 9:30am (SF office). Need: conf room C reserved, accessible seating, 8 parking passes, light breakfast (5 veg, 2 GF), shuttle at 9:00. Also one contractor still awaiting background vendor approval and hasn't uploaded I-9 docs. Any provisional start options? @LegalBot @Ravi
Sam - Facilities: Conf C booked 9-12, accessible route checked. Parking: can do 8 passes. Shuttle ok for 9:00 from Embarcadero lot. Send names by EOD.
Ravi - IT: Device imaging window: 9:20 or 10:05. We can also do hot-desk laptops if imaging delayed. Need asset types with emails. Badge printing: plan to print on the spot.
Maya - People Ops: I'll DM device types and emails. The contractor expects BG clearance in 3 days. Can we allow start before BG completes?
Kim - People Ops: For contractors, we usually wait on clearance for prod access. Could onboard them to non-prod and limited creds pending BG. Confirm with Legal.
LegalBot: Policy: Contractors may begin limited access work before BG completes at discretion of hiring manager and with documented mitigation. I-9: must be completed within 3 business days; remote notarization requires signed approval. Send case details to compliance@redwood.com.
Maya - People Ops: I'll ask hiring manager to accept non-prod access and flag compliance.
Jonah: I'll cover escorts. I'll be at lobby 9:15.
Hannah: One hire needs a wheelchair-accessible desk. Confirmed for Conf C.
Ravi - IT: Imaging command: `redwood-provision --cohort satellite --profile standard-v2`. If imaging delayed, hand out pre-imaged hot spares and schedule a follow-up imaging session same week.
Maya - People Ops: Catering order: 7 continental + 2 GF + coffee/tea. Any nut allergies?
Hannah: One nut allergy noted.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: satellite-day1-onboard (#12899). Due: 2026-05-04.
Maya - People Ops: Thanks everyone  I'll push calendar invites and tracker updates. Notifying compliance now about the BG/I-9 edge case.
Ravi - IT: Also, do any new hires need external monitor adapters? We have a small supply.
Maya - People Ops: I'll collect adapter requests in the RSVP form. Closing loop once compliance responds. Thanks!"
